annotations.title: Get a home health agency's Medicare record

description: OpenHealth gets one home health agency's Medicare record by its six-character CCN. The record includes Medicare's quality of patient care star rating, the patient survey stars and answers, every published quality measure with its denominator, the services the agency offers and its value-based purchasing score. Values are as CMS publishes them. A blank stays null.

ccn.description: The agency's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 367128.
